Octopus’s Shell Mystery

Pink, blue, pink, blue… tap the shell that comes next in every pattern.

Play the puzzle game ↓Print the worksheet ↓Play with a finger, a stylus or a mouse. Instructions are spoken aloud.
PLAY · PATTERN COMPLETION

Octopus’s Shell Mystery

Look at each shell pattern and tap what comes next!

Pink shell, blue shell, pink shell, blue shell… what comes next?

Small yellow, small blue, big purple, small yellow, small blue… what comes next?

Swirly, cone, cone, swirly, cone, cone… what comes next?

Shell mysteries solved!

Pink, big purple, and the swirly shell — all patterns finished.

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

This game trains pattern completion on the puzzle picture itself: the question is spoken aloud, the answers are pictures, and a miss brings a gentle hint instead of a penalty. Ask your child to explain the rule out loud — saying the “why” is the whole skill.

Prefer paper? The Octopus’s Shell Mystery worksheet prints the same puzzle with room to draw, sort and circle — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
